The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Is she holding us back? They said: She has performed the tawaf. He said: Then let her depart.

title: باب بَيَانِ وُجُوهِ الإِحْرَامِ وَأَنَّهُ يَجُوزُ إِفْرَادُ الْحَجِّ وَالتَّمَتُّعِ وَالْقِرَانِ وَجَوَازِ إِدْخَالِ الْحَجِّ عَلَى الْعُمْرَةِ وَمَتَى يَحِلُّ الْقَارِنُ مِنْ نُسُكِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، أَخْبَرَهُ عَمْرُو بْنُ أَوْسٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُرْدِفَ عَائِشَةَ فَيُعْمِرَهَا مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ ‏.‏
translation_en: The narrators transmitted this report through the stated chain. Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) during the Farewell Hajj. He explained the difference between the people who combined Hajj and Umrah and those who performed Umrah alone. When menstruation prevented her from the first tawaf, he told her to enter ihram for Hajj, complete Hajj, and then perform the Umrah that was due to her from Tan'im.
translation_de: Die Überlieferer übermittelten diesen Bericht über die genannte Kette. Aisha, möge Allah mit ihr zufrieden sein, sagte: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) während des Abschiedshadsch. He erklärte den Unterschied between the people who combined Hajj and Umrah and those who performed Umrah alone. Als die Menstruation sie am ersten Tawaf hinderte, sagte er ihr, sie solle in den Ihram für den Hadsch eintreten, den Hadsch zu vollenden, and then die ihr zustehende Umra von Tan’im aus zu verrichten. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben hier erhalten.
